warnings.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Maitland/Cessnock and Newcastle
warnings.summary: The Bureau of Meteorology warns that, at 2:40 pm, severe thunderstorms likely to produce damaging winds and large hailstones were detected near Kurri Kurri, West Wallsend and Boolaroo. These thunderstorms are moving towards the east. They are forecast to affect Maitland, Charlestown and Wallsend by 2:55 pm and Newcastle City, Raymond Terrace and Hexham by 3:10 pm.
warnings.title: Severe thunderstorm warning
